app.name: Human Ledger
app.tagline: A budgeting tool for people living in Japan

setup.title: First-time setup
setup.subtitle: Set your login details. All data stays on this machine.
setup.errorTooShort: Password must be at least 8 characters

dashboard.reconcileAlertDesc: The computed balance differs from the balance you entered — usually a missing transaction.
dashboard.emptyDesc: You need at least one account. Add the ones you actually use: bank, credit card, PayPay, cash.

txn.confirmDelete: Delete this entry? You can restore it from Trash.
txn.confirmDeleteTransfer: This is a transfer — the matching entry on the other account will be deleted too. Continue?
txn.transferNotEditable: A transfer's amount and accounts cannot be edited — changing one leg would break both balances. Delete it and re-enter instead.

form.installmentHint: Enter this month's payment in the Amount field, not the total. The total is kept for reference only.
form.excludeFromAnalysisHint: One-off large or unexpected spending (moving, a new laptop, a hospital stay…). Balances still include it; only the "everyday spending" in reports leaves it out.

transfer.feeHint: e.g. overseas transfer fee. Recorded separately as a real expense.
transfer.explainer: ATM withdrawals, top-ups, and card payments are transfers. They are excluded from income/expense totals so the same money is not counted twice.

account.name: Name
account.institutionHint: Filling this in lets imported screenshots be matched to this account automatically.
account.openingBalanceHint: The balance when you start tracking. For credit cards, enter outstanding debt as a negative number.
account.actualBalanceHint: Open your bank or payment app and enter the balance it shows.
account.reconcileExplainer: Reconciling is the cheapest way to catch missing entries: if the balance matches, nothing is missing.
account.reconcileHint: A positive difference suggests a missing income entry; negative suggests a missing expense.
account.emptyDesc: Add the ones you actually use: bank, credit card, PayPay, cash.

category.title: Categories
category.desc: Category names are stored per language and follow the interface language. Built-in categories can be renamed or hidden, but not deleted.
category.nameHint: Filling in just one language is fine — the others will reuse it.
category.errorNoName: Enter a name in at least one language

ocr.title: Screenshot recognition
ocr.desc: All three share one interface. None are wired up yet.

reason.notSelected: No recognition provider selected. Choose local or cloud in settings.
reason.localNotImplemented: Local OCR engine not wired up yet (planned for M2).
reason.cloudNoApiKey: Cloud recognition has no API key configured.
reason.cloudNotImplemented: Cloud recognition not wired up yet (planned for M2).

error.account_has_transactions: This account still has transactions. Archive it instead — the entries are kept.
error.category_in_use: This category is still in use and cannot be deleted.
error.system_category_hide_instead: Built-in categories cannot be deleted — hide it instead.
error.edit_transfer_via_delete_recreate: Transfer amounts cannot be edited directly. Delete and re-enter so both accounts stay consistent.
error.cannot_set_transfer_direction: Use the Transfer action for transfers
error.max_depth_two_levels: Categories are limited to two levels
error.type_must_match_parent: Sub-category type must match its parent
error.csv_unknown_format: Could not recognise the CSV format. Check the file or map the columns.
error.registration_disabled: Registration is disabled on this server

import.pasteDesc: Paste the text from a bank / card / PayPay screenshot, one item per line (long-press a screenshot to copy its text). Dates, amounts and merchants are recognised, de-duplicated and categorised for you to review. Paste several screens into one batch; overlapping rows are merged.
import.textPlaceholder:
ライフ 新宿店
842円
26.09.02
1回払い
…
import.statementMonthHint: Used to infer the year when dates lack one (e.g. J-WEST's 6月13日). Not needed when dates are complete.
import.previouslyImported: This text was imported before. Most rows will be flagged as duplicates; discard if this is a re-import.
import.installmentEstimatedWarn: An installment showed only its total; the monthly amount was estimated as total ÷ count. Please check.
import.confirmDiscard: Discard this batch? Recognised rows will be deleted.
import.reconcileOk: {{account}} balance matches the screenshot ({{amount}}), nothing missing.
import.reconcileDiff: {{account}} balance is off by {{amount}}; something may be missing.
import.rerouted: "{{file}}" is a {{profile}} file, so it went into "{{account}}". In the wrong account nothing is detected as a duplicate, and card payments count as spending.
import.accountMismatch: "{{file}}" looks like a {{profile}} file, but "{{account}}" is selected and no account of the right type exists. Create one first, or change the account row by row below.

staging.title: Review
staging.reasonExact: Identical to existing {{what}}, unselected by default
staging.reasonFuzzy: Similar to existing {{what}} ({{score}}%): could be the same, could be two real purchases
staging.reasonMerged: Overlapping screenshots: {{count}} identical rows merged into one
staging.transferHint: Looks like a transfer (payment / top-up / withdrawal). Counterpart:
staging.transferNotTransfer: Not a transfer, record as expense

exclude.paid_by_card: Paid by credit card (appears on the card statement)

staging.summaryTransferHint: Rows flagged as transfers are not counted as income or expense once confirmed
staging.appliedToSimilar: Also applied to {{count}} other rows from the same merchant
staging.reasonTransferLeg: This account already has the other side of this transfer: {{what}}

rules.title: Category rules
rules.desc: Rules take priority over learning and the built-in dictionary. Useful when the merchant name changes every time, e.g. SPOTIFY with a different transaction ID each month: one contains-spotify rule covers it. Case, width and spaces are ignored.

csv.desc: CSV statements downloaded from your bank or card issuer. SMBC bank statements, SMBC card, Rakuten Card (e-NAVI) and PayPay transaction history are detected automatically; other formats need column mapping. Select several files at once (e.g. several months) to import into one batch.
csv.filesHint: Shift_JIS and UTF-8 are detected automatically.
csv.accountSuggested: Account suggested from the file format. Please check.
csv.mappingDesc: This format is not recognised. Map the columns (amount can be one signed column, or separate withdrawal / deposit columns).

reports.trendHint: Last {{count}} months. Click a bar to switch month
reports.accountsHint: "This month" movement includes transfers, so account deltas don't add up to net.
reports.noData: No data for this month yet.
reports.legendHint: Click legend items to show / hide
reports.dailyHint: Click a day to see its transactions
reports.paceFaster: {{amount}} more than last month by day {{day}}
reports.paceSlower: {{amount}} less than last month by day {{day}}
reports.excludeFlaggedHint: Expenses marked "exclude from monthly analysis" (moving, a new laptop, a hospital stay…) are not counted as everyday spending
reports.excludedNotice: {{amount}} ({{count}} items) left out. Spending including them was {{raw}}.
reports.excludeCategoryHint: Hover a legend row and press ⊘ to leave a whole category out (e.g. rent).
reports.largeDesc: This month's biggest items. Switch off one-off or unexpected ones to leave them out of everyday spending.
reports.switchExcludeHint: Click to leave out of monthly analysis
reports.transferLike: Looks like a card payment, withdrawal or transfer — the money only moved between accounts.

backup.title: Backup & export
backup.desc: A full backup contains the database and uploaded screenshots and can be restored as-is on another machine. CSV export is for analysing in Excel or moving to another app.
backup.restoreHint: Restore: stop the server, then run in the backend directory

register.title: Sign up
register.subtitle: Create a new user. Accounts, categories and transactions are separate per user.

history.title: Import history
history.desc: Confirmed imports. If one went wrong you can undo it as a whole: its transactions move to the trash and the same file can be imported again.
history.descOverlap: Some imports repeat earlier records. Importing the same statement twice doubles the spending in reports; undo the extra import or remove its duplicates.
history.overlap: {{count}} of them already exist in the earlier {{with}}
history.overlapMostly: Almost all of it ({{count}}) already exists in the earlier {{with}} — this is most likely the extra copy
history.confirmRevert: Undo import #{{id}}? Its {{count}} transactions move to the trash (restorable).
history.confirmOverlaps: Move the {{count}} transactions in #{{id}} that already exist in earlier records to the trash? The earlier copy stays.
history.overlapLater: Overlaps with the later import {{with}}; handle it there
